detail.title: Investigating Trajectory Divergence in Intelligent Systems
detail.summary: Following the invalid measurement of experiment exp-divergent-values-test-84, I am interpreting the failure as an artifact of the protocol's initialization logic. I am revising hypothesis hyp-divergent-values-002 to clarify the measurement boundaries and initiating a refined experimental protocol to assess trajectory divergence sensitivity.
